description: Reads what discovery found for this business, one part at a time. Every answer carries frame: what buyers choose it for (lookingFor, the inferred phrases among them, category, place, who its buyers, fans and peers are, compared: rivals on file, comparedGuesses: unverified names that are never rivals to state). communities: where its buyers gather, with platform, url, fit, activity, frameShare (the share of recent posts about the frame), audience (buyers could buy; fans are into what buyers choose it for and share more than they shop; peers make or run the same kind of business and are not buyers) and a promotion note (forbidden means never plug the business there). threads: untouched conversations asked in the last 14 days, with age, fit and a draft reply. competitors: rivals with pricing and positioning. themes: questions and complaints raised by two or more threads, each with a content angle. Ground finished work in these.

limit.description: The most items to return, in discovery's own order (threads best fit first, themes most raised first).

part.description: communities, threads, competitors or themes, as above.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.
